description_en: Deletes one or more event targets of an event rule
description_zh: 删除一个事件规则下的一个或多个投递目标
kebab_example: aliyun eventbridge delete-targets --event-bus-name MyEventBus --rule-name ramrolechange-mns --target-ids 12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteTargets

parameters.help_en: The name of the event bus
parameters.name: event_bus_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the event rule
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the event targets that you want to delete
parameters.help_zh: 删除一个事件规则下的一个或多个投递目标
parameters.name: target_ids

Code.description_en: The response code. The code 200 indicates that the request was successful. Other codes indicate that the request failed. For information about error codes, see Error codes
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码：200：表示成功。                                 其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见错误码

ErrorEntries.description_en: The information about the event body that failed to be processed
ErrorEntries.description_zh: 处理失败的事件体信息

items.description_zh: 处理失败的事件体信息

EntryId.description_en: The ID of the event body that failed to be processed
EntryId.description_zh: 处理失败的事件体编号

ErrorMessage.example: The id of event target is duplicate!

ErrorEntriesCount.description_en: The number of event bodies that failed to be processed. Valid values: 0: No event bodies failed to be processed. An integer other than 0: the number of event bodies that failed to be processed
ErrorEntriesCount.description_zh:
处理失败的事件体数量。取值说明如下：
取值为0：所有事件均正常处理。
取值为除0以外的其他整数：处理失败的事件个数

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation is successful. Valid values: true and false
